jobs.description:
**Vice President, Head of Thickening

****Job Description

****Location

**Global

**Reports To

**Product Group Head – Separation

**Role Purpose

**The Head of Thickening role is accountable for the global business performance and growth of the Thickener product offerings across the entire product lifecycle, encompassing both Capital equipment and Upgrades & Rebuilds (U&R).

This role owns the global P&L, commercial strategy, market positioning, pricing strategy, and product roadmap. Responsible for driving aggressive volume growth while protecting and growing profitability targets by maximizing customer value and ensuring a seamless customer offering throughout the lifecycle of installed equipment.

Working across a complex matrix organization, the VP leads the commercialization of both new equipment, upgrades and rebuilds, partnering closely with Capital Sales, Regional Sales, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and Services, to accelerate growth and create sustainable competitive advantage.

**Executive Profile

**The successful candidate must combine strong commercial leadership with a recognized understanding of thickening technologies and their application in minerals processing.

While supported by a team of product managers, application engineers, and technical experts, the Head of Thickening must possess sufficient technical depth and industry credibility to engage confidently with customers, challenge assumptions, evaluate product strategies, and make informed business decisions. The role requires an executive capable of driving business growth while serving as a trusted authority on the Thickener portfolio across both Capital equipment and lifecycle solutions.

**Key Responsibilities

****Business and P&L Leadership

**

• Own the global P&L for the Thickeners portfolio, including Revenue, Operating Income, Contribution Margin, market share, and profitability.

• Develop and execute the long-term business strategy and growth plan for both Capital and Upgrades & Rebuilds businesses.

• Deliver aggressive growth targets through expansion of equipment sales, modernization programs, and installed-base opportunities.

• Manage business performance through rigorous forecasting, pipeline reviews, financial analysis, and strategic planning.

• Lead and develop a global team of Product Managers, Product Engineers, Applications / Proposals, Technical sales, etc.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer value, growth, and execution.

• Identify and develop new revenue streams, market opportunities, and business models that enhance lifecycle value creation.

**Commercial Leadership

**

• Define and implement global commercial strategies for Capital and U&R offerings.

• Lead the global sales growth agenda by partnering with Capital Sales teams, Regional Sales organizations, and key account leaders.

• Drive pipeline generation, conversion improvement, and sales excellence across all regions.

• Establish and govern global pricing strategies that optimize profitability while maintaining market competitiveness.

• Support major commercial negotiations and customer engagements for strategic opportunities.

• Monitor market dynamics, customer trends, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities and business risks.

**Upgrades & Rebuilds Growth

**

• Own the global strategy, growth, and profitability of the Upgrades & Rebuilds business within the Thickeners portfolio.

• Develop lifecycle offerings that increase customer productivity, sustainability, and equipment performance.

• Collaborate with regional commercial teams to identify modernization, expansion, and rebuild opportunities across the installed base.

• Establish standardized upgrade packages, retrofit solutions, and value propositions that are scalable globally.

• Drive alignment between global product strategy and regional commercial execution.

**Product and Portfolio Strategy

**

• Define the global product roadmap and lifecycle strategy for the Thickeners portfolio.

• Collaborate with Engineering to prioritize innovation investments and technology development.

• Lead market assessments to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and competitive opportunities.

• Ensure product offerings remain differentiated, profitable, and aligned with market requirements.

• Drive standardization, product optimization, digital offerings, and sustainable technology initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Leadership

**

• Lead and influence a highly matrixed global organization without relying solely on direct authority.

• Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Services, Finance, and Regional leadership teams to execute business objectives.

• Ensure alignment between commercial commitments, operational capabilities, and customer expectations.

• Support execution excellence throughout the order lifecycle to maximize customer satisfaction and long-term portfolio success.

**Candidate Profile

**The ideal candidate is a commercially driven business leader with deep experience in thickening technology and minerals processing. They have successfully managed a significant product line, business unit, or portfolio with responsibility for growth, profitability, and market strategy. They are equally comfortable discussing thickener performance and applications with customers and engineers as they are leading commercial negotiations, reviewing business performance, and driving strategic growth initiatives.

**Experience

**

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience within mining, minerals processing, capital equipment, or industrial technology businesses.

• Significant experience with thickening technologies, dewatering solutions, or adjacent process equipment used in mineral processing operations.

• Demonstrated understanding of thickener applications, customer processes, operational challenges, product performance drivers, and aftermarket opportunities throughout the equipment lifecycle.

• Proven success leading a global business, product line, service line, or business unit with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.

• Strong commercial leadership experience, including business development, sales strategy, pricing, market expansion, and P&L ownership.

• Track record of driving growth across both capital equipment sales and aftermarket offerings such as upgrades, rebuilds, modernization programs, and lifecycle services.

• Experience working across highly matrixed global organizations and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Established credibility engaging with customers, engineering teams, technical specialists, and regional commercial organizations at a strategic level.

**Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent preferred.

**Core Competencies

**

• Commercial Leadership

• P&L Management

• Strategic Thinking

• Stakeholder Management

• People Leadership

• Thickening Technology Expertise

• Sales & Business Development

• Lifecycle Solutions Management

• Results orientation

FLSmidth is the leading supplier of engineering, equipment and service solutions to customers in the mining and minerals industries – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

Join us in this role where you’ll be part of a highly motivated, dynamic and social team focusing on financial lifecycle cost analysis of future and existing offshore wind projects. You’ll obtain key insights into our development pipeline and existing fleet where you will ensure best-in-class financial and investment support for our global offshore organization.

We are looking for an OPEX Financial Analyst with exceptional analytical skills to transform complex datasets into actionable insights. Proficiency in Excel and the ability to present findings clearly to various stakeholders are essential.

**Welcome to Technical Budgeting and Analysis

**You’ll be part of a team where you, together with your colleagues, will develop and benchmark operational lifetime budgets for our existing and future wind farms.

As a team, we will provide all analysis of OPEX cost and support management in taking decisions based on financial and business insights.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• taking ownership of your own portfolio of offshore wind projects and the responsibility to support our Offshore business with lifecycle cost assessments and financial analysis

• providing lifecycle cost assessment and financial analysis to our development projects during Bid, FID and maturation phase (incl. risk-, FX- and local content analysis)

• providing relevant high-quality financial analysis on OPEX activities for commercial decision support as well as presenting and reporting to senior management

• working with our M&A Valuation & Structuring team to support our divestment processes through quantitative evaluation of various O&M activities and concepts.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have keen interest in business and cost analysis and are curious to understand fundamental financial drivers behind the business case of an offshore wind farm

• have relevant work experience in the field of lifetime cost modelling, budget forecasting, financial analysis or similar

• thrive in an international, dynamic and fast paced, project environment where you keep the financial overview to ensure the integrity of our business cases and financial commitments

• have a positive can-do attitude and excellent communication skills to ensure complex financial matters are understood by all stakeholders and management

• are highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, enjoy working with large financial models and have a proactive mindset towards change.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

HEGSØ Search & Consulting has the task of finding a skilled Machine Learning Engineer for our client, the leading subsea technology and development company Teledyne RESON.

Job Purpose:

Turn noisy, real-time sensor data into robust machine-learning solutions.

As Machine Learning Engineer you join a multidisciplinary engineering team developing ML for target detection, sonar imaging and pattern recognition in streaming acoustic data. Your work will connect sensors, signal processing, high-performance computing and the information ultimately presented to users.

The sensor systems generate large volumes of real-time data, which is transformed into software products for visualization, post-processing and analysis. The processing chain combines demanding real-time computation with FPGA, DSP and GPU hardware.

You will help develop both the ML models and the infrastructure around them. Because the ML infrastructure supports internal development and customer on-site use, robustness, efficiency and control are central to the role. You will work with industry-standard tools as well as in-house technology.

This is a rare opportunity to apply machine learning to difficult, meaningful data alongside maritime domain experts, software engineers, mathematical modelling engineers and embedded-processing specialists.

What makes the role distinctive:

• Challenging data – find structures and patterns in noisy streaming acoustic and hydrophone data

• End-to-end impact – work from sensor input and model development through to information presented to the user

• Industrial ML – turn novel ML technology into robust, efficient products for internal and customer use

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop machine-learning and data-science solutions for target detection in sonar acoustic data and imaging systems

• Identify structures and patterns in data from hydrophones

• Develop ML models and contribute to the ML infrastructure used in the software products

• Be an active member of a development team spanning software, mathematical modelling and dedicated embedded-processing hardware

• Communicate concepts across the development chain, from sensor input to the final information presented to the user

• Propose improvements to ML models and infrastructure

• Help bring novel ML technologies into robust, industrialized products

• Keep current with relevant technologies and tools

Essential skills:

• Experience with general machine-learning technologies, modern modelling techniques and deep-learning frameworks – PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar

• Understanding of software quality assurance principles and build tools, plus a successful track record in ML development

• Ability to manage and span substantial multi-year engineering efforts while contributing as a hands-on team player

• Strong technical communication skills and proficiency in English

Useful additional experience:

• A background in mathematics, physics or optics, with an understanding of the physics and nature of acoustics

• Experience with related signal-processing domains such as hearing aids, 5G telecom, radar or ultrasound

• Experience with relevant software and tools such as Git, Jira and build systems

Qualifications & Experience:

• An MSc or PhD in engineering is a strong foundation, but an experienced professional background can be equally relevant

• The right candidate may come from different disciplines and career paths

Behavioural Competencies:

• Self-driven, enjoys difficult technical challenges and keeps pushing toward ambitious goals

• Collaborates well and communicates well in a global team distributed between countries

• Takes ownership and responsibility, delivers to agreements and keeps promises

• Enthusiastic, energetic ‘can-do’ attitude

• Interested in new technologies, industry challenges and in the products, use cases, customers and the marine domain

What we offer:

• A collaborative workplace with strong colleagues and a company that takes good care of its employees

• A high level of ambition and the time to build high-quality products within a company recognized globally for world-class sonar systems

• A development path that supports your continued professional growth

• Interesting products, markets and customers, including leading research organizations, global industrial companies and defence organizations

About Teledyne RESON: Teledyne RESON is a world leader in high-quality underwater acoustic solutions – multibeam sonars, sensors, transducers and survey software. Founded in Denmark in 1976 and part of Teledyne since 2013, with headquarters, R&D and production in Slangerup.

Job location

Copenhagen, Denmark is preferred because close collaboration between ML and software engineers is important to the role.

If you want to know more, please contact:

Anders Hegelskov, HEGSØ Search & Consulting, Phone: +45 3035 6405 – Mail: ah@hegsoe.dk

The role

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own the processes and data behind our sales organization: the sales process, definitions, forecasting and commissions.

This is an individual contributor role in our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security. You'll be supported by the RevOps team and work closely with sales leadership and Finance. We're looking for around 5+ years of hands-on experience in VC or PE-backed companies.

What you'll do

Forecasting

• Define shared sales terms and metrics such as pipeline, stage probabilities, bookings, and new versus expansion business.

• Establish a forecasting baseline: forecast categories, submission rules and a first method for new business and expansion.

• Track forecast accuracy and refine the method as data quality improves.

• Build pipeline and forecast reports and dashboards in Salesforce.

• Set up a pipeline and forecast review cadence with sales leadership once the definitions are in place.

Sales process

• Own the sales process from qualified opportunity to closed deal, including stages, exit criteria and the hand-over to delivery and Finance.

• Set up territories, account ownership and rules for partner and cross-sell deals.

Commissions

• Help automate the commission process with the right tooling, from data capture to calculation and payout.

• Work with Finance and sales leadership on plan design and changes.

Sales systems

• Shape how Salesforce (including Revenue Cloud/CPQ) supports the sales process, and make hands-on changes where needed.

• Keep sales data clean with required fields, validation rules and deduplication.

• Automate manual steps in the sales process with workflows and AI.

• Work with CRM vendors and implementation partners, including evaluations, renewals, support and new functionality.

• Train and support sales reps on system and process changes.

Stack harmonization

We grow through acquisition. In October 2026 we announced our combination with WoodWing, adding four products and more than 200 colleagues. Harmonizing the sales stack and processes of acquired companies is a big part of this job, done together with the RevOps team and the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security.

• Bring each acquired sales team, starting with WoodWing, onto our shared sales process, pipeline stages, definitions and reporting.

• Move acquired sales reps onto group commission plans.

• Set account ownership and cross-sell rules between entities, and resolve duplicate accounts.

• Assess each acquired company's sales systems and migrate accounts, contacts, opportunities and products into Salesforce in phases, including from HubSpot.

• Build a repeatable playbook for the next acquisition.

Your qualifications

Essential

• Around 5+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations in B2B SaaS

• Experience building a sales forecast from the ground up, including the definitions and data quality behind it

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards and flows

• Experience designing and rolling out sales processes

• Experience administering sales commissions

• Experience consolidating CRMs or sales processes after an acquisition, or running sales operations across several entities

• Good understanding of sales metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle and bookings

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, including migrating from HubSpot to Salesforce

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ experience

• Experience implementing commission software

• Using AI in sales workflows

Soft skills

You're comfortable with change and ambiguity, as our processes keep developing with each acquisition. You build trust with sales leaders and sales reps, prefer practical solutions you can improve over time, and help new colleagues adapt to shared ways of working.

What kind of company is Omnidocs?

We recognize that in different phases of life, you need different kinds of flexibility, and we are happy to provide that. It could be that you prefer to work from home once or twice a week or occasionally need to leave early for a soccer tournament, a parents’ meeting, or a romantic date. We find small talk between co-workers valuable, so your lunch break is part of your working hours, and we invest in quality coffee beans for the cozy and useful interactions across teams by the coffee machine. It may sound like little things, but the overall message is that we want you to meet trust, kindness, and helpfulness at work because we expect that this is what you bring as well. The purpose of our company is just as internal as it is externally communicated: We make every workday work better.

We also love to connect. We do social activities such as LAN parties, board game afternoons, and Friday Cafes. Our office is located in the heart of the historic neighborhood of Christianshavn, surrounded by canals and great little cafés and restaurants. We have plenty of light and air while being close to everything – including the metro, the canals, and the city center.

How to apply – important information!

As we strive to have an unbiased recruitment process, we ask you to be attentive to the following when applying.

1- Include a resume with relevant professional experience, skillset, and educational background.

2- Answer all required questions in the submission form when uploading.

3- Use the dedicated application link (do not send your resume over e-mail).

4- Do NOT share: a cover letter / motivated application a picture of yourself (if it’s part of your resume, please remove it before uploading) information about your gender or sex your first name (enter the first letter of your first name instead) your age or birth date

Processing of personal data By registering in our HR system, BambooHR, and uploading both application and CV, you accept that Omnidocs stores the registered data about you and the data included in the uploaded documents. All information is used solely for recruitment purposes and will be deleted within 12 months of upload. Please do not include person-sensitive data in the application and CV, e.g. CPR number, information about race, religion, trade union conditions, and health information. You can read about Omnidocs' guidelines for processing personal data here: https://omnidocs.com/processing-of-personal-data-in-the-context-of-recruitment/

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team and help us scale infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability across our growing backend ecosystem.

You will work alongside our senior platform engineers on our Kubernetes-native stack, taking ownership of real infrastructure from early on. This is a role where you'll learn by building: our environment is modern and opinionated, and you'll be running production infrastructure for financial institutions, not sandbox projects.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how systems work, comfortable being new to things, and eager to grow fast in a high-bar environment.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain our AWS infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt, starting with well-scoped modules and growing into larger architectural work.

• Kubernetes Operations: Support our EKS clusters and a rapidly growing microservices environment (NestJS backend), handling deployments, troubleshooting, and day-to-day cluster health.

• CI/CD Pipelines: Build and improve pipelines with GitHub Actions in a trunk-based development environment, so deployments stay safe and fast.

• GitOps: Work with ArgoCD-driven workflows and learn to own them end to end.

• Observability: Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and dashboards, helping us catch problems before customers do.

• Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers and security stakeholders, applying cloud security best practices with AWS-native tooling.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• High-Agency Learner: You dig into problems you haven't seen before instead of waiting to be shown. You ask good questions and you don't ask the same one twice.

• Foundations: 1–3 years in DevOps, SRE, Platform, or backend engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Cloud & Containers: Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should be comfortable navigating both and understand what's happening underneath.

• Automation Instinct: Hands-on experience with Terraform or another IaC tool, and a preference for scripting something over doing it twice by hand.

• CI/CD Familiarity: You've worked with pipelines before, ideally GitHub Actions, and understand why deployment safety matters.

• Scripting & Systems: Comfortable with Linux, Git, and at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, or similar).

• Communication: You can explain what broke and why to an engineer who wasn't there.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Cloud & Orchestration: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm

• IaC: Terraform, Terragrunt

• CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub/Gitlab, ArgoCD

• Observability: DataDog

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

jobs.occupation: Project lead (strain engineering for client delivery)
jobs.description:
Enduro Genetics is a world-leading biotech at the interface of synthetic biology and biomanufacturing. Our platform product Enduro Sense is a transformative gene technology that redefines the capabilities of cells in fermentation. Enduro Sense is used for cell-based expression systems and production strains to deliver higher titer, rate and yields, making biomanufacturing more efficient and scalable.

As we expand to meet growing client demands, we are seeking a results-driven and people-oriented Project Lead to oversee our microbial strain engineering projects with clients.

Who You Are:

This role is perfect for a senior science leader passionate about leveraging synthetic biology to create tangible biomanfacturing step-ups for clients while fostering team growth and motivation. You thrive in fast-paced settings, communicate clearly and are eager to join a rapidly scaling company, currently around 25 employees.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and mentor high-performing R&D teams to drive project success.

• Develop and implement research strategies to meet key milestones.

• Oversee client projects to ensure timely progress and impactful results.

• Collaborate with scientists and stakeholders of all levels to deliver on project timelines and deliverables.

• Provide expert technical guidance to support project outcomes.

What You Bring:

• Education: PhD in Synthetic Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years in microbial strain engineering, with corporate expertise in pharmaceutical or industrial bioprocesses.

• Technical Expertise:

• Strong background in production strain technology, recombinant protein expression, or metabolite production.

• Proven track-record in developing microbial strains for bioprocesses.

• Leadership: Exceptional project management skills, including team mentorship and development.

• Analytical and Communication: Ability to solve complex problems and communicate effectively incl. in written and oral presentations.

• Adaptability: Capacity to excel in a dynamic, fast-growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience leading agile R&D teams.

• Technical strain engineering experience in Bacillus, E. coli, Corynebacterium or yeasts (Pichia, S. cerevisiae etc)

• Familiarity with corporate bioprocess development workflows.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), small-scale automation, and fermentation science.

• Background in pharmaceutical GMP environments.

• Relevant experience from e.g. a CDMO or CRO on delivering projects with clients or collaboration partners

Why Join Enduro Genetics?

At Enduro, you'll play a vital role roling out our technology to leading clients, shaping the future of biomanufacturing. Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions make a difference.

If you're ready to advance your career in industrial biotechnology and lead impactful projects, apply now to join our team.

Applications will be screened regularly

jobs.occupation: Event & Experience Manager – Bring Axlab’s customer experiences to life
jobs.description:
Can you turn a showroom visit, a reference site tour or an industry exhibition into an experience that makes a lasting impression?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for an Event & Experience Manager who combines creative design with hands-on delivery and a clear commercial focus.

In the position you will own Axlab’s customer-facing experience programme: reference site visits, the headquarters showroom, Axlab Academy, and industry exhibitions. This is an opportunity to combine concept development with practical execution, shaping how visitors experience Axlab’s solutions and building the calendar, materials and processes that ensure consistent quality and continuity.

Your role goes beyond logistics: you will design welcoming, relevant experiences that help visitors understand how Axlab’s solutions work in practice. You will also build the calendar, materials and documented processes that make the programme consistent, scalable, and less dependent on any one individual.

You will be part of the Marcom team and work closely with Sales, Product Management, and external partners. Together with the Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator, you will translate ideas into a strong exhibition presence and cohesive creative execution.

What you will take ownership of

• 
Develop and deliver reference site visits, showroom tours, Academy days and exhibitions that connect customer needs with Axlab’s automated pathology workflows.

• 
Establish and continually improve the showroom experience and reference site concept for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Manage programmes and events from concept to delivery, aligning internal teams, external agencies, and production partners.

• 
Build and maintain the activity calendar, supporting materials, briefings, and documented processes.

• 
Manage suppliers, budgets, and negotiations, with close attention to production details and on-site logistics.

•

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of the entire go-to-market in one place: lead generation, new business, partners and existing customers. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

Lead generation is yours as a minimum. You own where the meetings come from: the customer profile, the lead lists and the sourcing of the right webshops, outbound and the campaigns that have to fill the pipeline. You measure what a meeting costs to acquire and which channels carry, and you shut down the ones that do not. You build it yourself at first and set direction for marketing and meeting booking as they come on board.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished sales organisation. You build the commercial side together with the founder, and what you decide on price, pitch, process and the first hires is what Userlink will sell on for years.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

• Some React/TypeScript experience, and willingness to make occasional frontend changes

✅ What We Expect at Senior Level

You can independently take a feature or technical problem from requirements to a production-ready solution. You're comfortable navigating unfamiliar code, understanding the blast radius of a change, and making pragmatic calls between delivery speed, reliability and maintainability.

You think carefully about system boundaries and integration contracts, understanding that APIs used by customers and external systems need to evolve safely and behave predictably when either side fails. You understand rollback, backwards compatibility, failure modes and safe deployment for systems handling production data.

You communicate trade-offs clearly and take responsibility for the quality of what you ship.

You're comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of your day-to-day work, and curious about how they can improve how software is designed, built, tested and maintained - not just for code generation, but for understanding unfamiliar code, planning changes, testing, reviewing, debugging and documentation. At the same time, you apply strong engineering judgement: you treat AI-generated output as a draft to review and validate, and you remain responsible for the correctness and security of what you ship.

🌟 Nice to Have

• Enterprise integrations - SSO/federated identity, webhooks, customer-facing APIs

• AWS CDK or similar IaC tooling

• DynamoDB single-table or composite-key modelling

• IoT, connected devices, telemetry or high-volume event processing

• Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

• Energy tech, EV charging, batteries, solar or energy management

• Data platforms, analytics or data lakes

• ISO 27001 or NIS2 experience

• Next.js

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains fast.

🌆 What Is It Like to Work at FLEXECHARGE?

• Our office sits in Frederiksberg - bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday

• You're covered with pension contributions

• Lunch is on-site, delicious, and genuinely healthy and nutritious

• We like each other's company outside of work too, so think Friday bars, plus company team events and team buildings on a team level

• Opportunities for individual development

🤝 Our Interview Process

Here's roughly what happens once we've had a look at your application:

• A first conversation, about 30 minutes, you'll talk with our recruiter, get a feel for the role, ask whatever's on your mind, and we'll both get a sense of whether this is worth pursuing further

• Time with the team - a conversation with Artur, our Head of Engineering, and Robert, our CTO

• A technical stage - one or more interviews with the team, which may include a case exercise and follow-up discussions. These can take place remotely or at our office.

• A conversation with Max, our CEO, alongside someone else from the team

Hiring carefully matters to us - we want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you. Find a link to apply here 👉 https://thehub.io/jobs/6ab5030dfd5518f38b6960b2?utm_source=client&utm_medium=dashboard&utm_campaign=startupshared

📍 Location & Practical Details

This is an on-site role based in Copenhagen.

Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

Please note:

• We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role

• We do not offer relocation services

🔐 Data Privacy (GDPR)

• Applications for this role are processed exclusively through The Hub (thehub.io), our recruitment platform, in accordance with their privacy policy and applicable GDPR requirements. As part of our interview process, conversations may be recorded and transcribed via Microsoft Teams, and AI tools may be used to summarize interview notes to support our hiring team's evaluation. Your data will be handled confidentially, retained only during the interview process, and used only for this recruitment process. If you have questions or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact us at iva@flexecharge.com .

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems
jobs.description:
_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

• You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

• You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

• You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.

• You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.

• You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. Autonomy works only when paired with initiative, collaboration, sound judgment, and follow-through.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be technically strong enough to recognise weak abstractions, incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, security problems, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• Trust and meaningful responsibility from your first day, with the opportunity to influence both our platform and how we build it.

• Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

• The opportunity to define an AI-native approach to developing complex financial software and see your work reach customers quickly.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

jobs.occupation: Technical Lead - Substation Automation and Communication Systems
jobs.description:
Do you have experience with automation and communication systems for high-voltage substations? Can you lead technical work packages and coordinate specialist contributions to deliver an integrated solution? Join COWI as our new Technical Lead and contribute to the development of Denmark’s electricity transmission infrastructure.

Take technical responsibility for substation automation projects

We are looking for an experienced engineer to take technical responsibility for substation automation and communication systems in high-voltage substation projects. You will work on projects ranging from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites. You will coordinate specialist contributions, manage technical interfaces and ensure that individual work packages meet the requirements of the overall substation automation solution.

The role combines technical expertise with responsibility for coordinating engineering activities, monitoring progress and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables. You will work closely with the project manager, technical specialists and other engineering disciplines throughout project execution.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead and coordinate the technical delivery of substation automation and communication systems.

• Plan and follow up on engineering activities, technical deliverables and milestones within your scope.

• Coordinate specialist contributions and ensure consistency across technical work packages.

• Ensure that technical solutions and documentation comply with project requirements, customer specifications and applicable standards.

• Manage technical interfaces between automation, communication systems, protection systems, primary equipment and auxiliary systems.

• Identify and resolve technical issues in collaboration with specialists and other engineering disciplines.

• Participate in project meetings and advise the project manager on technical matters, dependencies and risks within your area of responsibility.

• Coordinate technical activities with customers, suppliers and other project stakeholders.

Your expertise

You combine a strong technical foundation with a structured approach to planning and coordination. You can assess how individual systems and specialist contributions fit together, communicate technical requirements clearly and follow through on agreed actions.

You work independently and build effective working relationships with colleagues, customers and project partners.

You will also bring:

• A degree in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical qualification, together with more than five years of relevant experience in automation for high-voltage substations.

• A solid understanding of substation automation systems, including control and monitoring functions, communication networks and interfaces to protection equipment.

• An understanding of how substation secondary systems interface with high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience coordinating technical work packages, planning engineering activities and following up on specialist deliverables.

• The ability to assess technical solutions, manage interfaces and maintain an overview of quality, progress and dependencies.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and fulfil the requirements for the designated on-site role of “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Travel within Denmark is expected.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Carsten Sass Husum at CSHU@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employer

COWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
